accepted_claims: For arbitrary real polynomials p,q and nonnegative integers i,j, p^(2i+1) and q^(2j+1) SOS imply (p+q)^(2i+2j+1) SOS; credited published Blekherman–Kozhasov–Reznick result with Pinelis ingredient.
For every fixed real c<3, all sufficiently large odd powers of f_c(x,y)=x^4*y^2+x^2*y^4+1-c*x^2*y^2 are sums of real polynomial squares.
The thresholds defined by {c: f_c^(2k+1) is SOS}=(-infinity,c_k] satisfy lim_{k to infinity} c_k=3.
The optional direct local calculation gives real delta(M_c)=6 for 0<c<3; it is not needed for the threshold conclusion.
not_claimed: A new mixed-exponent theorem, historical priority or novelty of the threshold application, or exhaustive literature clearance.
An explicit SOS exponent, explicit square-root certificate, convergence rate, or uniform exponent for all c<3.
An affirmative SOS conclusion at c=3 or a total-real-delta conclusion of 6 at that endpoint.
A reproof of Scheiderer Corollary 4.2 or projective-space cohomology; these are credited published inputs.
Dependence on the Stubborn Polynomials preprint for the principal threshold proof, or independent foundational acceptance of its Del Pezzo/resolution criteria.
External human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification.
publication_edition: Authored proof-only; full principal proof, full substantive acceptance and complete credited mixed-exponent proof/corrections.
principal_method: Positive quadratic section on integral singular cubic ABC=D^3; published Scheiderer Corollary 4.2; hypersurface section lifting; polynomial substitution.
essential_imported_inputs: Scheiderer, A Positivstellensatz for projective real varieties, Corollary 4.2 (published 2012).
source_display_corrections: Even positivity index 2r; homogenization summation upper limit 2r. Both fully disclosed in CREDITED_MIXED_EXPONENT_PROOF.md.
